notes: rf_we registered 1 cycle behind pc update in S_WRITEBACK; corrupted AUIPC/JAL/JALR writeback data. Fixed: made rf_we combinational.
AUIPC+JALR self-jump offset was 12 not 20 (li pseudo-op is 2 instructions). Test bug, not CPU bug.
cc1 missing libmpfr.so.4 (system only has .so.6). Built MPFR 3.1.6 from source to user prefix, no root needed.
ZEN-6033 elaboration error: whole-array $readmemh init + sub-word bit-sliced always_ff write to same array violates LRM 9.2.2.4. Fixed: write whole word via read-modify-write.
Linker script missed .sdata/.sbss/.srodata (RV32 ABI default placement for small globals); g_zero fell outside the bss-clear range. Added those input sections.
g_initialized was constant-folded by -O1 since never mutated, silently defeating the .data-load test. Made it volatile.
Testbench do_read sampled mem_rdata one cycle after the DUT's clear-on-read side effect already committed (race in the TEST, not the DUT). Fixed sampling protocol.

Read-data pipeline was CAS_LATENCY+1 deep with an extra registered output stage, adding 2 cycles of latency the controller doesn't wait for. All reads returned high-Z. Fixed to exactly CAS_LATENCY depth, combinational output stage.
